commentaryList.commText: Wellington Masakadza to Mitchell Marsh, B0$ Bowled!! Only just clips the outside of off stump, enough to dislodge the bails, and Masakadza is pumped. It's a peach of a delivery. Tossed up from round the wicket, drifts in, lands on a good length, and Marsh is caught in the crease in defence. It grips just enough to square him up before kissing the off stump. Should've been forward there. But finally Zimbabwe have a breakthrough. B1$
